title: BDS 2022-23
category: Medical & Dental Questions > Dental English Questions

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: why you are angry with your brother?
what time did you go to bed last evening?
please tell me why have you come here?
what you passed your BA examination?
questions.explanation: WH-question এর নিয়মানুসারে, Wh-word + auxiliary verb + subject + main verb + বাকি অংশ বসে

questions.question: Choose the correct word/words to fill up the blank. We shall _____ the work before he comes.
questions.explanation: Future perfect tense এর structure: subject + shall have/will have + V3 + বাকি অংশ।

questions.question: Fill up the gap with the right word. My mother had me........... milk every day.
Identify the correct sentence-
options: My son does not like the vegetable
Someone is knocking in the door
questions.explanation: Discuss এর পর কোনো preposition ব্যবহৃত হয় না। বাকি অপশন গুলোর ক্ষেত্রে the vegetable এর স্থলে vegetables; walk এর স্থলে a walk এবং knocking in এর স্থলে knocking at হলে sentence গুলো correct হবে।

questions.question: The synonym of 'trivial' is-
questions.explanation: Trivial (নগন্য/তুচ্ছ) এর synonymous words হলো insignificant, negligible, trifling, inconsequential ইত্যাদি।

questions.question: A learner of language is known as-
questions.explanation: Philologist A learner of language; misogynist A person who hates women; misologist - One who dislikes reasoning or argument; bibliophilist - A lover of books.

questions.question: Choose the correct answer.
options: an idle man cannot prosper at life
idle man cannot prosper in life
an idle man cannot prosper in life
the idle man cannot prosper of life
questions.explanation: Prosper in life জীবনে সাফল্য অর্জন করা। singular common noun দ্বারা অনির্দিষ্ট কাউকে বুঝালে তার পূর্বে article হিসেবে a/an বসে। উপরোক্ত বাক্যে man এর পূর্বে idle (যা vowel দ্বারা শুরু) শব্দটি থাকায় এক্ষেত্রে article "an" বসবে।

questions.question: Which expression is correct?
questions.explanation: এক্ষেত্রে head হলো zero plural অর্থাৎ কখনোই plural form গ্রহণ করবে না। যেমন: ten head of cattle

questions.question: Make one word of the following sentence: "Incapable of being explained"
questions.explanation: Inexplicable অর্থ ব্যাখ্যা করা যায় না এমন (incapable of being explained); Incredible অবিশ্বাস্য; Inexplicit অস্পষ্ট; Inexpressible অবর্ণনীয়।

questions.question: Which one of the following is a causative verb?
questions.explanation: Causative verb হিসেবে help ব্যবহৃত হলে sentence এর structure হয় subject + help + indirect object + V3 + direct object |

questions.question: Which one is the correct indirect speech of "Come here"?
options: He told me to go there
He ordered that I go there
He told that I should come here
questions.explanation: Imperative sentence দ্বারা যদি আদেশ, অনুরোধ, উপদেশ না বুঝিয়ে সাধারণ অর্থে ব্যবহৃত হয় তাহলে indirect করার সময় reporting verb হিসেবে tell/told বসে।

questions.question: The necklace is made of gold. What kind of noun is the word 'gold'?
questions.explanation: যে noun দ্বারা ওজন আছে কিন্তু গণনাযোগ্য নয় এমন কিছুর নাম বুঝায় তাকে material noun বলে। যেমন: Gold, Milk, Salt, Iron, Cloth, Glass, Silver ইত্যাদি।

questions.question: Change the given sentence into a complex one. 'Tell me your name.'
options: tell me what is your name
tell me the name your bear
tell me what your name is
questions.explanation: Embedded question এর নিয়মানুযায়ী WH-word + subject + verb বসে।

questions.question: Which one is the correct passive sentence?
options: By whom it is painted with?
With whom it is painted by?
questions.explanation: Interrogative sentence এর active voice, who দ্বারা শুরু হলে passive করার ক্ষেত্রে by whom + auxiliary verb + object এর subject + V3 অথবা who + auxiliary verb + object এর subject + V3 + by হয়।

questions.question: He "passed himself" off as a noble man. The words in quotation marks mean-
questions.explanation: Passed oneself off as someone - মিথ্যা পরিচয় দেয়া।
